title: School Nutrition Services Meal Account: Application Determination and Income Verification Timetable
content:
School Nutrition Services administers household meal benefit applications and the annual income verification for every School Nutrition Services Meal Account on the timetable below.

| Meal status | Can be selected for income verification |
|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status | no |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | no |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | yes |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | no |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | yes |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | no |
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | no |

| Timetable item (the same for every status) | Value |
|---|---|
| Date by which the district selects its verification sample of approved household applications | October 1 (10-01) |
| Calendar days a household selected for verification has to submit documents, the selection letter date being day 0 | 10 |
| Calendar days of advance written notice before a status is reduced or terminated after verification, the notice date being day 0 | 10 |
| Operating days within which a submitted household application must be determined | 10 |
| A household may submit a new application at any time during the school year | yes |

## Examples on hypothetical dates

- A selection letter dated on a Monday (day 0) gives the household through the Thursday of the following week (day 10) to send documents.
- Only the two statuses that rest on a household application can be selected; a student on direct certification or categorical eligibility is never in the sample.
